instruction: A `90°` sector annulus template `/home/user/Desktop/cyclic_base.inp` is provided. Complete the following from the command line: 1. Modify and generate `/home/user/Desktop/cyclic.inp`: Please save the final input file as /home/user/Desktop/cyclic.inp. - Repair missing nodes and invalid element connectivity so the C3D8 sector mesh is valid - Define cyclic symmetry with 4 sectors (full `360°`) and sector-side symmetry faces (Master and Slave) - Apply pressure `10 MPa` on the inner surface 2. Submit the job and write a post-processing script to parse `cyclic.dat`: - Extract maximum Mises stress from the stress output - Compare against full-cylinder Lame solution (`23.13 MPa`) and compute error percent - Write to `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` in this format: `max_mises, lame_error_percent` 3. Do not use the CGX GUI. [Software] Run `ccx --version` or invoke the installed `ccx` binary from a terminal. For this task, use `/usr/bin/ccx` for the CalculiX solve and `/usr/bin/cgx` when CGX processing is needed.
